subject: Vendor ledger onboarding — data needed to create Cirrus Dynamics profile
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: onboarding@cirrusdynamics.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-07-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor ledger onboarding — data needed to create Cirrus Dynamics profile

Hi Lena / Cirrus onboarding team,

Thanks for partnering with Redwood Inference. To get Cirrus into our vendor ledger and enable PO issuance and invoice routing, we need a few items to create the legal profile and payment routes. Please provide the following (PDF copies preferred):

- Legal entity name exactly as registered (including DBA if applicable)
- Tax ID / EIN (or local tax registration number)
- Registered (legal) address and mailing address if different
- Remittance address (if invoices should go to a different address)
- Primary AP contact name, email and phone for invoice follow-ups
- Preferred invoice email address and invoice file format (PDF, EDI, etc.)
- W-9 (or equivalent tax form) and any VAT registration docs if applicable
- Bank wiring instructions or ACH mandate (account number can be partially masked in email)
- Authorized signers for contracts (name, title, email)
- Beneficial ownership or UBO declaration if required by your jurisdiction

If you prefer to upload documents, you can use our vendor portal: https://redwoodvendors.example.com/portal/submit/ABCD1234. Otherwise, reply to this thread with attachments.

Timeline: once we receive validated docs, finance will create the vendor code within 3 business days and enable PO acceptance. If any of the items above need additional steps (notarization, apostille), flag them so we can adjust the timeline.

Thanks — small ask list but helps finance avoid delays.

Best,
David Kim
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Lena Morales <lena.morales@cirrusdynamics.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: onboarding@cirrusdynamics.com
Date: 2027-07-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor ledger onboarding — data needed to create Cirrus Dynamics profile

Subject: Re: Vendor ledger onboarding — routing & tax check

David / Ben — quick internal note after reviewing Lena's reply:

- Tax ID looks valid format; Finance should verify EIN against IRS/TIN service before creating vendor code.
- PO routing: set POs to route to procure@redwoodinference.com and copy invoices@cirrusdynamics.com. Finance prefers PO contact as procurement@redwoodinference.com for automated matching.
- Bank details: Ben, can you kick off the micro-deposit/verification workflow with Treasury for the masked acct ****7890? Mark as high priority for first-payment readiness.
- Vendor code: recommend code prefix CIRR- followed by 5 digits (e.g., CIRR-01234). Marissa, please own vendor code assignment and update the vendor registry once Finance confirms EIN and bank verification.

> From: Lena Morales <lena.morales@cirrusdynamics.com>
> Attached: W9_CirrusDynamics_2027.pdf, ACH_Cirrus_2027.pdf

Thanks — keeping the timeline tight since PoCs are scheduled next month.

Kimberly Park

Lena — got the attachments, thank you. Next steps: 

1) Finance will validate the EIN and kick off bank verification (Ben will follow up directly on micro-deposit timeline).
2) Marissa will assign the vendor code once validations pass and confirm in this thread.
3) We will generate the first PO and route it to procure@redwoodinference.com; please expect an automated PO acknowledgement email.

If you prefer to upload to the portal instead of replying, the upload link is: https://redwoodvendors.example.com/portal/submit/ABCD1234 — either way works for us.

One ask: please confirm whether Cirrus requires net-30 payment terms or a different standard so we can set default payment terms in the ledger.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
David Kim
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
